BiospecimenMetadataTemplate: This template collects information about the biospecimen, aka samples, used to generate data. One row represent a distinct biospecimen. Each biospecimenID is expected to be unique within this template and more broadly across a given program. The same biospecimenID are expected to be used in corresponding Assay and File Annotation templates.
BulkATACSeqAssayMetadataTemplate: This template collects assay-level metadata for your bulk ATAC-seq dataset. Each row is expected to correspond to a single library that was generated and sequenced. libraryID is expected to be unique within this template.
BulkRNASeqAssayMetadataTemplate: This template collects assay-level metadata for your bulk RNA-seq dataset. Each row is expected to correspond to a single library that was generated and sequenced. libraryID is expected to be unique within this template.
CITESeqProcessedDataAnnotationTemplate: This template collects file-level metadata and curates your file with this critical information thereby enabling discoverability, SQL queries, and overall organization and metrics calculations of your data files.
ClinicalMetadataTemplate: This template collects information about the individuals, aka subjects, from whom samples are collected and used for data collection. One row represent a distinct individual. Each individualID is expected to be unique within this template and more broadly across a given program. The same individualID are expected to be used in corresponding Assay and File Annotation templates.
CyTOFAssayMetadataTemplate: The template collects assay-level metadata for your flow cytometry data. Each row is expected to correspond to a single vial of cells that were sampled. If your vials contained a pool of multiple samples please reach out the ARK Portal team for further instructions.
FastqFileAnnotationTemplate: This template collects file-level metadata and curates your file with this critical information thereby enabling discoverability, SQL queries, and overall organization and metrics calculations of your data files.
FCSFileAnnotationTemplate: This template collects file-level metadata and curates your file with this critical information thereby enabling discoverability, SQL queries, and overall organization and metrics calculations of your data files.
FeatureBarcodeSequencingAssayMetadataTem: This template collects assay-level metadata for the feature barcode, aka ADT, libraries. Each row is expected to correspond to a single library that was generated and sequenced. libraryID is expected to be unique within this template and should correspond to the librayIDs specified for concomitantly generated libraries, e.g., scRNA-seq libraries in a CITE-seq experiment.
FlowCytometryAssayMetadataTemplate: The template collects assay-level metadata for your flow cytometry data. Each row is expected to correspond to a single vial of cells that were sampled. If your vials contained a pool of multiple samples please reach out the ARK Portal team for further instructions.
InVitroBiospecimenMetadataTemplate: This template collects information about the biospecimen, aka samples, used to generate data. One row represent a distinct biospecimen. Each biospecimenID is expected to be unique within this template. The same biospecimenID are expected to be used in corresponding Assay and File Annotation templates. Please use the sampleCollectionBatch to specify critical batching information that may be needed to support downstream analyses.
MetadataFileAnnotationTemplate: This template collects file-level metadata and curates your file with this critical information thereby enabling discoverability, SQL queries, and overall organization and metrics calculations of your data files.
OlinkAssayMetadataTemplate: The template collects assay-level metadata for your Olink data. Each row is expected to correspond to a single plate. plateID is expected to be unique within this template. The same plateID are expected to be used in corresponding File Annotation template.
OlinkFileAnnotationTemplate: This template collects file-level metadata and curates your file with this critical information thereby enabling discoverability, SQL queries, and overall organization and metrics calculations of your data files.
ScRNASeqAssayMetadataTemplate: This template collects assay-level metadata for your single-cell RNA-seq dataset. Each row is expected to correspond to a single library that was generated and sequenced. libraryID is expected to be unique within this template.
ScRNASeqProcessedDataAnnotationTemplate: This template collects file-level metadata and curates your file with this critical information thereby enabling discoverability, SQL queries, and overall organization and metrics calculations of your data files.
ScVDJSeqProcessedDataAnnotationTemplate: This template collects file-level metadata and curates your file with this critical information thereby enabling discoverability, SQL queries, and overall organization and metrics calculations of your data files.
SnATACSeqAssayMetadataTemplate: This template collects assay-level metadata for your single-nucleus ATAC-seq dataset. Each row is expected to correspond to a single library that was generated and sequenced. libraryID is expected to be unique within this template.
SnATACSeqProcessedDataAnnotationTemplate: This template collects file-level metadata and curates your file with this critical information thereby enabling discoverability, SQL queries, and overall organization and metrics calculations of your data files.
SnRNASeqAssayMetadataTemplate: This template collects assay-level metadata for your single-nucleus RNA-seq dataset. Each row is expected to correspond to a single library that was generated and sequenced. libraryID is expected to be unique within this template.
SnRNASeqProcessedDataAnnotationTemplate: This template collects file-level metadata and curates your file with this critical information thereby enabling discoverability, SQL queries, and overall organization and metrics calculations of your data files.
SpatialImagingAssayMetadataTemplate: The template collects assay-level metadata for your spatial imaging dataset. Each row is expected to correspond to a single slide that was profiled. slideID is expected to be unique within this template. The same slideID are expected to be used in corresponding File Annotation template.
PublicationMetadataTemplate: This template specifies metadata to collect for publications tracked and surfaced in the portal.
DatasetAnnotationTemplate: This template specifies the metadata used to annotate Dataset entities for th ARK Portal.
SpatialImagingFileAnnotationTemplate: This template collects file-level metadata and curates your file with this critical information thereby enabling discoverability, SQL queries, and overall organization and metrics calculations of your data files.
